audit_metadata.milestone: Phase 5 Step 4.3 — Independent Verification of Anomaly Agent Remediation

COND-1.title: Downstream Failure Masking via AnomalyExecutionStatus and Status-Aware Supervisor Routing
key_findings: Explicit AnomalyExecutionStatus enum ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA') correctly defined in backend/app/agents/enums.py and exported in backend/app/agents/__init__.py.
Both AnomalyDetectionResult and AnomalyAssessment include execution_status field defaulting to SUCCESS.
Pydantic model validator validate_assessment_invariants strictly forbids anomaly_detected=True and requires anomaly_type=NONE when execution_status is FAILED or INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

SupervisorAgent.evaluate() enforces 4 explicit status-aware routing branches: FAILED routes to FAIL_WORKFLOW, INSUFFICIENT_DATA routes to ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN_GATE, SUCCESS with anomaly routes to ROUTE_TO_ROOT_CAUSE_ANALYSIS, and SUCCESS with no anomaly routes to COMPLETE_WORKFLOW only if confidence > 0.0 and assessment is valid.
Stale failure records cannot mask a later failure; stale success records cannot mask a later failure because anom_res.execution_status == FAILED directly triggers FAIL_WORKFLOW.

COND-2.title: Pressure Baseline Operational Envelope Alignment with Training Distribution

COND-3.title: Agent Scope and Sequence Reconstruction Documentation Rectification
key_findings: AnomalyDetectionAgent docstring and module header accurately state point-in-time tabular Isolation Forest scope.
No misleading claims of active 30-step sequence reconstruction exist in anomaly_agent.py.
Dead constant LSTM_AUTOENCODER_FROZEN_THRESHOLD removed from anomaly_agent.py.
Existing LSTM Autoencoder artifact ml/models_store/lstm_autoencoder.keras remains intact and verified (SHA256: b1cae16de57b556f13b3f96e12a8c451d05f3bdd9887a65172817cd99e30e0b5).
Future contract for deferred TemporalSequenceAgent clearly documented.

COND-4.title: Real Model Artifact Integration and Kernel SHAP Verification Without Mocks
COND-4.additivity_notes: Mathematical exactness is achieved because 5 features evaluate the full 2^5 = 32 coalition lattice (nsamples=32), yielding floating-point precision additivity.
COND-4.ci_status_note: No GitHub Actions CI workflow is configured in the repository; integration was independently verified in the Windows Python 3.11.9 runtime.

non_blocking_observations.observation: SupervisorAgent.evaluate() checks has_failed_execution = any(rec.execution_status == FAILED for rec in anom_execs). In the current single-pass DAG this correctly forces failure routing. If multi-turn retry loops within the same graph run are implemented in later phases, evaluation should check the latest execution record rather than historical attempts.

Real model integration tests were verified in the local Python 3.11 Windows runtime. No remote GitHub Actions workflow is currently configured in the repository; automated CI execution should be established in Phase 6 deployment packaging.
